In 2025, Canada’s demand for blue-collar workers remains strong, especially in industries like construction, manufacturing, logistics, and skilled trades. With an ongoing blue-collar labour shortage and high turnover, it’s more important than ever for employers to understand what attracts and retains Canadian workers in these vital roles.
